insights.summary: The speaker describes a system for organizing information from meetings, documents, and audio recordings into a structured format with editable elements and AI assistance for identifying missing information and generating content.
goals: Enable convenient searching of meetings via a menu with projects, folders, and meetings.
Implement navigation by menu, folders, and projects, similar to Desant.
Allow artifact addition, including schema blocks, Wiki documents, and ecosystem maps.
Enable text insertion via typing or copy-pasting.
Ensure LLM understands the primary task from added elements, even without explicit connections.
Highlight missing elements (e.g., "just to be done" for the client) using the system.
Provide descriptions and tags for each block to ensure schema clarity.
Allow editing of mission statements with AI assistance (e.g., using Claude).
Enable Claude to identify and fill in missing important elements in product descriptions.
Facilitate the creation of user stories from the information added in the first layer.
Allow adding a schema to the data block to specify how data is pulled and structured.
ideas: Use color-coding to indicate the type of block for quick understanding of information sources.
Implement a system where clicking on a block reveals its description and tags.
Create a second layer of schemas within the first, allowing for nested maps and document addition.
Use a visual indicator (exclamation mark) to show when a block is missing information.

new_block_proposals.title: Artefact Search
new_block_proposals.mission: This block provides a search functionality for finding meetings, projects, and folders within the system.  It allows users to quickly locate specific information based on keywords or tags. The search should be integrated with the menu and navigation system, similar to the Desant prototype.  This ensures easy access to relevant artefacts. The search functionality will improve user efficiency and reduce the time spent locating information. It will support various artefact types, including blocks, schemas, documents, and even entire ecosystem maps.
acceptance: Search returns relevant meetings based on keywords.
Search returns relevant projects based on keywords.
Search returns relevant folders based on keywords.
Search supports searching within artefact descriptions and tags.
Search results are displayed in a clear and organized manner.
new_block_proposals.rationale: The transcript explicitly mentions the need for a search function for meetings, projects, and folders.

new_block_proposals.title: Visual Schema Editor
new_block_proposals.mission: This block enables users to create and edit visual schemas representing relationships between different artefacts. Users can add artefacts (blocks, documents, text) to the canvas and connect them to illustrate dependencies and information flow. The editor will support linking artefacts with labeled connections, specifying the type and direction of the relationship.  It will allow users to define the information extracted from each artefact and its purpose. The visual schema editor will improve understanding of complex systems and facilitate knowledge sharing. The editor will support multiple layers of schemas, allowing users to create schemas within schemas.
acceptance: Users can add artefacts to the canvas.
Users can create and label connections between artefacts.
Users can specify the direction of the relationship between artefacts.
Users can add text descriptions to artefacts and connections.
Users can create nested schemas (schemas within schemas).
new_block_proposals.rationale: The transcript describes a system for creating visual representations of information flow and dependencies between artefacts.

new_block_proposals.title: Mission Statement Editor
new_block_proposals.mission: This block allows users to define and edit the mission statement for a product or project. The editor provides a dedicated space for crafting a clear and concise mission statement. It includes a description field for elaborating on the mission. The editor will integrate with a large language model (LLM) like Claude to assist users in refining and improving their mission statements. This ensures that the mission statement is well-articulated and aligned with the project goals.
acceptance: Users can create a mission statement.
Users can edit the mission statement.
Users can add a description to the mission statement.
Users can use Claude to rewrite the mission statement.
The mission statement is saved and associated with the product/project.
new_block_proposals.rationale: The transcript explicitly mentions the ability to edit the mission statement using Claude.
